integrity: Proof and finite-field checker included; computations do not substitute for the infinite claim; independent scientific assessment remains outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the fixed cyclic Klein model over the prime field of characteristic two, not all twists or Fano surfaces.
Exact point counts up to extension degree seven were independently enumerated; all higher-degree values follow from the cohomological proof.
A general Hermitian-twist zeta formula might imply this special value; historical equivalence searches are incomplete.
title: Ten-step Frobenius invisibility on the characteristic-two Klein cubic
